math-holder">\mu=\frac{1}{C_p}[T(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T})_p-V]\\</span></span></span>1.理想气体</p><p data-pid="fDwUIUlo"><span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="pV=\nu RT"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">pV=\nu RT</span></span></span> ， <span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="\mu=\frac{1}{C_p}(\frac{\nu RT}{p}-V)=0"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">\mu=\frac{1}{C_p}(\frac{\nu RT}{p}-V)=0</span></span></span> ，节流温度不变</p><p data-pid="eC8js2Mj">2.范氏气体</p><p data-pid="vAheSl3M"><span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="(p+\frac{\nu^2a}{V^2})(V-\nu b)=\nu RT"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">(p+\frac{\nu^2a}{V^2})(V-\nu b)=\nu RT</span></span></span> </p><p data-pid="Nxcs7_Yd"><span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T})_p由(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T})_p(\frac{\partial p}{\partial V})_T(\frac{\partial T}{\partial p})_V=-1得到"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T})_p由(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T})_p(\frac{\partial p}{\partial V})_T(\frac{\partial T}{\partial p})_V=-1得到</span></span></span> </p><p data-pid="IQWSv6k1"><span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T})_p=-(\frac{\partial V}{\partial p})_T(\frac{\partial p}{\partial T})_V=-(\frac{\partial V}{\partial p})_T(\frac{\nu R}{V-b})"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore data-pid="2GgaJcvQ"><span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="\mu=\frac{1}{C_p}[-T(\frac{\partial V}{\partial p})_T(\frac{\nu R}{V-\nu b})-(\frac{\partial V}{\partial p})_T(\frac{\partial V}{\partial p})_T(\frac{\nu R}{V-\nu b})-(\frac{\partial V}{\partial p})_T(\frac{\partial p}{\partial V})_TV]\\ =\frac{1}{C_p}[-T(\frac{\partial V}{\partial p})_T(\frac{\nu R}{V-\nu b})-(\frac{\partial V}{\partial p})_T(-\frac{\nu RTV}{(V-\nu b)^2}+\frac{2a\nu^2}{V})]\\ =\frac{1}{C_p}(\frac{\partial V}{\partial p})_T[-\frac{\nu^2 RTb}{(V-\nu b)^2}+\frac{2a\nu^2}{V}]\\</span></span></span> 其中 <span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="(\frac{\partial V}{\partial p})|_T一般&lt;0"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore data-pid="F5m-yflk">下把（6.15）加油吧）</p><hr><p data-pid="0YnbUWeX">战败后补充知识点：</p><h3>1.可逆过程</h3><p data-pid="LqTILxBe">1.理想气体可逆过程：从理解上来说，既然可以两个方向进行，那必然是熵变为0。</p><p data-pid="8TjZm0Az">也可以经过计算（可逆过程要求外界和内部时刻保持温度一致），又因为总热交换为0</p><p data-pid="xFpAgXiR">则熵变为0。</p><p data-pid="W5tHlXHo">2.范德瓦尔斯气体可逆过程理论上确实也可行，只要有无限缓慢的过程，时刻平衡的系统（温度时刻内外相等）</p><p data-pid="wWgd6kv0">综上：可逆其实只与过程的性质（准<span><a class="RichContent-EntityWord css-b7erz1" data-za-not-track-link="true" data-paste-text="true" data-za-not-track-link="true" data-paste-text="true" href="https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=257546310&amp;content_type=Article&amp;match_order=1&amp;q=%E8%8A%82%E6%B5%81%E8%BF%87%E7%A8%8B&amp;zhida_source=entity" target="_blank">节流过程<svg width="10px" height="10px" viewBox="0 0 16 16" class="ZDI ZDI--FourPointedStar16 css-1dvsrp" fill="currentColor"><path d="m5.068 9.267-3.08-.77a.512.512 0 0 1 0-.994l3.08-.77a2.289 2.289 0 0 0 1.665-1.665l.77-3.08a.512.512 0 0 1 .994 0l.77 3.08c.205.82.845 1.46 1.665 1.665l3.08.77a.512.512 0 0 1 0 .994l-3.08.77a2.29 2.29 0 0 0-1.665 1.665l-.77 3.08a.512.512 0 0 1-.994 0l-.77-3.08a2.289 2.289 0 0 0-1.665-1.665Z"></path></svg></a></span></h3><p data-pid="K4VREas9">仔细考察一下这个过程，会发现里面有和活塞的摩擦，所以一定是<span><a class="RichContent-EntityWord css-b7erz1" data-za-not-track-link="true" data-paste-text="true" href="https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=257546310&amp;content_type=Article&amp;match_order=1&amp;q=%E4%B8%8D%E5%8F%AF%E9%80%86%E8%BF%87%E7%A8%8B&amp;zhida_source=entity" target="_blank">不可逆过程<svg width="10px" height="10px" viewBox="0 0 16 16" class="ZDI ZDI--FourPointedStar16 css-1dvsrp" fill="currentColor"><path d="m5.068 9.267-3.08-.77a.512.512 0 0 1 0-.994l3.08-.77a2.289 2.289 0 0 0 1.665-1.665l.77-3.08a.512.512 0 0 1 .994 0l.77 3.08c.205.82.845 1.46 1.665 1.665l3.08.77a.512.512 0 0 1 0 .994l-3.08.77a2.29 2.29 0 0 0-1.665 1.665l-.77 3.08a.512.512 0 0 1-.994 0l-.77-3.08a2.289 2.289 0 0 0-1.665-1.665Z"></path></svg></a></span>。</p><p data-pid="4GD8NGux">或者根据 <span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="\Delta H=0=\Delta(U+pV)=\Delta S-V\Delta p"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">\Delta H=0=\Delta(U+pV)=\Delta S-V\Delta p</span></span></span> ，而整体p改变，所以一定有熵变。</p><p data-pid="2KSiBSTi">（和理想气体与范德瓦尔斯气体也没关系）</p><p data-pid="ueSfxAgz">理想气体因为JT系数为0，可以直接根据压强来算熵变 <span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="\nu R\ln \frac{p_1}{p_2}"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">\nu R\ln \frac{p_1}{p_2}</span></span></span> </p><p data-pid="iB6pL_bi">范德瓦尔斯气体：按熵公式定义写。</p><h3>3.杜隆帕蒂定理</h3><p data-pid="OqLWGDlT">固体热容与温度无关，一直是3R（其实是德拜声子模型推的）</p><h3>4.范德瓦尔斯气体性质补充</h3><p data-pid="czL5hMRy">1.内能</p><p data-pid="6zgBBJve"><span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="(\frac{\partial U}{\partial V})_T=T(\frac{\partial p}{\partial T})_V-p"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">(\frac{\partial U}{\partial V})_T=T(\frac{\partial p}{\partial T})_V-p</span></span></span> ，按方程计算即可</p><p data-pid="eevehCNK">再 <span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="(\frac{\partial U}{\partial T})_V=C_V"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">(\frac{\partial U}{\partial T})_V=C_V</span></span></span> ，再按 <span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="dU=(\frac{\partial U}{\partial V})_T dV+(\frac{\partial U}{\partial T})_VdT"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">dU=(\frac{\partial U}{\partial V})_T dV+(\frac{\partial U}{\partial T})_VdT</span></span></span> </p><p data-pid="SqasAPuB"><span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="U=C_VT-\frac{a}{V}+U_0"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">U=C_VT-\frac{a}{V}+U_0</span></span></span> </p><p data-pid="4xxwB2Mt">2.熵变：还是按照 <span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="dQ=dW+dU"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">dQ=dW+dU</span></span></span> , 现在已经知道内能表达式了。</p><p class="ztext-empty-paragraph"><br></p><h3>5.（绝热）自由膨胀</h3><p data-pid="r2j_fTOl">（绝热）Q与（自由）W均为0，所以 <span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="\Delta U=0"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">\Delta U=0</span></span></span> </p><p data-pid="2J8Y0BY0">但是注意！！！熵变确实有定义式 <span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="dS=\frac{dQ}{T}"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">dS=\frac{dQ}{T}</span></span></span> ，但有条件是“<span><a class="RichContent-EntityWord css-b7erz1" data-za-not-track-link="true" data-paste-text="true" href="https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=257546310&amp;content_type=Article&amp;match_order=1&amp;q=%E5%87%86%E9%9D%99%E6%80%81%E8%BF%87%E7%A8%8B&amp;zhida_source=entity" target="_blank">准静态过程<svg width="10px" height="10px" viewBox="0 0 16 16" class="ZDI ZDI--FourPointedStar16 css-1dvsrp" fill="currentColor"><path d="m5.068 9.267-3.08-.77a.512.512 0 0 1 0-.994l3.08-.77a2.289 2.289 0 0 0 1.665-1.665l.77-3.08a.512.512 0 0 1 .994 0l.77 3.08c.205.82.845 1.46 1.665 1.665l3.08.77a.512.512 0 0 1 0 .994l-3.08.77a2.29 2.29 0 0 0-1.665 1.665l-.77 3.08a.512.512 0 0 1-.994 0l-.77-3.08a2.289 2.289 0 0 0-1.665-1.665Z"></path></svg></a></span>”连接。</p><p data-pid="BtfeG6BT">例如范德瓦尔斯气体绝热自由膨胀，由绝热自由知道 <span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="\Delta U=0"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">\Delta U=0</span></span></span> ，而体积变化已知，所以可求T变化。</p><p data-pid="y2K9p-Uf">构造一个等温+等压过程。 <span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="dS=\frac{(\frac{RT_0}{V-b}-\frac{a}{V^2})dV}{T_0}"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">dS=\frac{(\frac{RT_0}{V-b}-\frac{a}{V^2})dV}{T_0}</span></span></span> 积分得第一段 <span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="\Delta S=R\ln \frac{2V_0-b}{V_0-b}"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">\Delta S=R\ln \frac{2V_0-b}{V_0-b}</span></span></span> </p><p data-pid="3wgFZMOR"><span><a class="RichContent-EntityWord css-b7erz1" data-za-not-track-link="true" data-paste-text="true" href="https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=257546310&amp;content_type=Article&amp;match_order=1&amp;q=%E7%AD%89%E4%BD%93%E8%BF%87%E7%A8%8B&amp;zhida_source=entity" target="_blank">等体过程<svg width="10px" height="10px" viewBox="0 0 16 16" class="ZDI ZDI--FourPointedStar16 css-1dvsrp" fill="currentColor"><path d="m5.068 9.267-3.08-.77a.512.512 0 0 1 0-.994l3.08-.77a2.289 2.289 0 0 0 1.665-1.665l.77-3.08a.512.512 0 0 1 .994 0l.77 3.08c.205.82.845 1.46 1.665 1.665l3.08.77a.512.512 0 0 1 0 .994l-3.08.77a2.29 2.29 0 0 0-1.665 1.665l-.77 3.08a.512.512 0 0 1-.994 0l-.77-3.08a2.289 2.289 0 0 0-1.665-1.665Z"></path></svg></a></span>： <span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="dQ=du=C_VdT"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">dQ=du=C_VdT</span></span></span> ，由 <span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="\Delta U=0"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">\Delta U=0</span></span></span> 可以得到<span><a class="RichContent-EntityWord css-b7erz1" data-za-not-track-link="true" data-paste-text="true" href="https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=257546310&amp;content_type=Article&amp;match_order=1&amp;q=%E6%9C%AB%E6%80%81&amp;zhida_source=entity" target="_blank">末态<svg width="10px" height="10px" viewBox="0 0 16 16" class="ZDI ZDI--FourPointedStar16 css-1dvsrp" fill="currentColor"><path d="m5.068 9.267-3.08-.77a.512.512 0 0 1 0-.994l3.08-.77a2.289 2.289 0 0 0 1.665-1.665l.77-3.08a.512.512 0 0 1 .994 0l.77 3.08c.205.82.845 1.46 1.665 1.665l3.08.77a.512.512 0 0 1 0 .994l-3.08.77a2.29 2.29 0 0 0-1.665 1.665l-.77 3.08a.512.512 0 0 1-.994 0l-.77-3.08a2.289 2.289 0 0 0-1.665-1.665Z"></path></svg></a></span>温度。</p><p class="ztext-empty-paragraph"><br></p><h3>6.化学势</h3><p data-pid="IpKwLSAh"><span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="d\mu=dH-Td S"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">d\mu=dH-Td S</span></span></span> ，相平衡点两相的化学势相等</p><hr><p data-pid="BvAZrtEM">简评：难得吓人（和往年以及模拟比），MB分布疑似有点多了。</p><p
